resources.string: Keep a portable copy of your Reality history. Your activities, schedules, sessions, breaks and timestamps are stored on this phone.
Save a JSON file wherever you choose. It includes archived activities and a current streak snapshot; reports and streaks can be rebuilt from the complete history.
This file contains readable activity history. Keep it somewhere private. Passwords, login tokens and database credentials are never included.
Choose a Reality backup from this phone or a file transferred from your computer. The complete file is checked before any phone data changes.
For existing localhost data, run Export-Reality-Localhost.ps1 on your computer, transfer the resulting JSON file to this phone, then choose it here. No server is needed after import.
This replaces all existing Reality data on this phone, including running sessions. Export a backup first if you want to keep the current data. Your computer database is not changed.
All data restored. Streaks and reports now use your imported history.
